current_answer: Choose a skill by the job, agent, source revision, and project context. OpenDesigner is a conditional option when you need to create a design system and persistent tokens; its own instructions say to use an existing DESIGN.md for a one-off screen instead of starting another interview. For frontend output, keep the same brief and project in a no-skill comparison, then check visual-system fit and working behavior separately. No listed skill has a pool-run paired outcome test.
